events.title: Scenario: Data-center AI growth may push transformer demand above near-term supply
events.summary: AI-driven data-center growth could drive concentrated transformer demand and procurement stress in the near term. Operators and buyers should monitor lead-times and specification alignment.

events.title: Scenario: Transformer supply-chain friction may extend lead times
events.summary: Transformer manufacturing backlogs and logistics uncertainty could lengthen delivery times for specialized units, prompting procurement and design trade-offs.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC deployment could accelerate offshore-wind integration but require converter and specialized transformer demand
events.summary: HVDC corridors can ease renewable integration but channel demand toward converters and specialized transformers; rapid deployment may create procurement bottlenecks.

events.title: Scenario: Battery storage shortages may constrain ancillary service supply
events.summary: Battery shortages could reduce available ancillary services, increasing reliance on alternative flexibility and potentially raising short-term system costs.

events.title: Scenario: Uptick in mining investment could diversify battery-material supply but with lead-time uncertainty
events.summary: New mining investment could lower long-term concentration risk for battery materials but may not eliminate near-term production bottlenecks.

events.title: Scenario: AI-based grid controls expand but raise cybersecurity and governance exposures
events.summary: Wider AI control adoption offers efficiency gains but concentrates cyber and governance risks that require updated standards and operator practices.

events.title: Scenario: OEM consolidation signals could increase procurement concentration and lead-time risk for EPCs
events.summary: OEM consolidation may raise procurement concentration and lead-time risk for EPCs, prompting earlier contracting or design adjustments.

events.title: Scenario: New reliability targets could prioritize substation retrofit funding
events.summary: Stricter reliability targets may speed substation retrofit spending, concentrating demand for replacement transformers and associated hardware.

events.title: Scenario: Predictive maintenance analytics may lower outage risk but raise data-governance questions
events.summary: Predictive maintenance can reduce outages and optimize asset life but increases the need for clear data-governance and access controls.

events.title: Scenario: Renewable curtailment patterns may create market signals for flexible generation and storage
events.summary: Curtailment-driven market signals could accelerate investments in flexible resources, altering the balance between transmission investments and local storage/generation.
